amc10-2000-q1.summary: In 2001 the United States will host the International Mathematical Olympiad. Distinct positive integers $I,M,O$ satisfy $IMO=2001$. Find the largest possible value of $I+M+O$. Options: A $23$, B $55$, C $99$, D $111$, E $671$.
amc10-2000-q1.summaryZh: 2001 年美国将主办国际数学奥林匹克。互不相同的正整数 $I,M,O$ 满足 $IMO=2001$。求 $I+M+O$ 的最大值。选项为 A $23$，B $55$，C $99$，D $111$，E $671$。

methods.title: Factor and compare the divisor triples
methods.titleZh: 分解质因数并比较因数组
steps: Factor $2001=3\cdot23\cdot29$. A largest sum can use $1$ as one factor; the other distinct factor pairs are $(3,667),(23,87),(29,69)$.
Their sums with $1$ are $671,111,99$. If no factor is $1$, splitting the three prime factors gives $3+23+29=55$. Hence the maximum is $671$.
stepsZh: 分解得 $2001=3\cdot23\cdot29$。为使和尽量大，可令一个因数为 $1$；其余两个不同因数的配对为 $(3,667),(23,87),(29,69)$。
对应总和为 $671,111,99$。若不含 $1$，只能把三个质因数分别分配，和为 $55$。所以最大值为 $671$。

methods.title: Add exponents with the same base
methods.titleZh: 同底数幂相乘指数相加

amc10-2000-q3.summary: Each day Jenny eats $20\%$ of the jellybeans present at the beginning of that day. After the second day, $32$ remain. How many were present originally? Options: A $40$, B $50$, C $55$, D $60$, E $75$.
amc10-2000-q3.summaryZh: Jenny 每天吃掉当天开始时糖豆数的 $20\%$。第二天结束时剩下 $32$ 颗。最初有多少颗？选项为 A $40$，B $50$，C $55$，D $60$，E $75$。

methods.title: Work backwards with the remaining fraction
steps: Each day leaves $80\%=0.8$ of the previous amount.
If the original amount is $x$, then $(0.8)^2x=32$, so $x=32/0.64=50$.
stepsZh: 每天结束时留下原有数量的 $80\%=0.8$。

amc10-2000-q4.summary: An online service bill equals a fixed monthly fee plus an hourly connection charge. The December bill was 12.48 dollars. January cost 17.54 dollars after twice as much connection time. Find the fixed fee. Options: A 2.53, B 5.06, C 6.24, D 7.42, E 8.77 dollars.
amc10-2000-q4.summaryZh: 某在线服务账单由固定月费与按小时计费的上网费组成。12 月账单为 12.48 美元；1 月上网时间是 12 月的两倍，账单为 17.54 美元。求固定月费。选项为 A 2.53，B 5.06，C 6.24，D 7.42，E 8.77 美元。

methods.title: Use the increase to recover the variable charge
methods.titleZh: 用账单增量求可变费用
steps: Let the fixed fee be $F$ and December's connection charge be $H$. Then $F+H=12.48$ and $F+2H=17.54$.
Subtracting gives $H=5.06$, so $F=12.48-5.06=7.42$ dollars.

amc10-2000-q5.summary: In triangle $PAB$, $M,N$ are the midpoints of $PA,PB$. Point $P$ moves along a fixed line parallel to $AB$. How many of these quantities change: (a) $MN$; (b) the perimeter of $PAB$; (c) the area of $PAB$; (d) the area of trapezoid $ABNM$? Options: A $0$, B $1$, C $2$, D $3$, E $4$.
amc10-2000-q5.summaryZh: 在三角形 $PAB$ 中，$M,N$ 分别为 $PA,PB$ 的中点。点 $P$ 沿一条与 $AB$ 平行的定直线移动。下列量中有几个会改变：(a) $MN$ 的长度；(b) 三角形 $PAB$ 的周长；(c) 三角形 $PAB$ 的面积；(d) 梯形 $ABNM$ 的面积？选项为 A $0$，B $1$，C $2$，D $3$，E $4$。

methods.title: Use the midsegment theorem and constant altitude
steps: The midsegment theorem gives $MN=AB/2$, so (a) is fixed. Because $P$ stays on a line parallel to $AB$, its altitude to $AB$ is fixed, hence (c) is fixed.
Triangle $PMN$ has one quarter the area of $PAB$, so trapezoid $ABNM$ has three quarters of the same fixed area; (d) is fixed. The side lengths $PA,PB$ vary, so only the perimeter (b) changes.
stepsZh: 由中位线定理，$MN=AB/2$，故 (a) 不变。由于 $P$ 在与 $AB$ 平行的直线上移动，到 $AB$ 的高不变，因此 (c) 不变。
三角形 $PMN$ 面积是三角形 $PAB$ 的四分之一，所以梯形面积为其四分之三，也不变。$PA,PB$ 会变化，故只有周长 (b) 改变。

amc10-2000-q6.summary: The Fibonacci sequence begins $1,1,2,3,5,8,\ldots$. Which digit is the last of the ten digits to appear as a units digit of a Fibonacci number? Options: A $0$, B $4$, C $6$, D $7$, E $9$.
amc10-2000-q6.summaryZh: 斐波那契数列从 $1,1,2,3,5,8,\ldots$ 开始。十个数码中，最后一个作为某项个位数出现的是哪个？选项为 A $0$，B $4$，C $6$，D $7$，E $9$。

methods.title: Track only residues modulo ten
steps: By the time $6$ first appears, every other digit has already appeared. Thus $6$ is last.
stepsZh: 当 $6$ 首次出现时，其余九个数码都已出现，所以最后出现的是 $6$。

amc10-2000-q7.summary: In rectangle $ABCD$, $AD=1$ and $P$ lies on $AB$. Rays $DP$ and $DB$ trisect the right angle $ADC$ in the order $DA,DP,DB,DC$. Find the perimeter of triangle $BDP$. Options: A $3+\sqrt3/3$, B $2+4\sqrt3/3$, C $2+2\sqrt2$, D $(3+3\sqrt5)/2$, E $2+5\sqrt3/3$.
amc10-2000-q7.summaryZh: 在长方形 $ABCD$ 中，$AD=1$，点 $P$ 在 $AB$ 上。射线 $DP,DB$ 按 $DA,DP,DB,DC$ 的顺序三等分直角 $ADC$。求三角形 $BDP$ 的周长。选项为 A $3+\sqrt3/3$，B $2+4\sqrt3/3$，C $2+2\sqrt2$，D $(3+3\sqrt5)/2$，E $2+5\sqrt3/3$。

methods.title: Use two 30-60-90 triangles
steps: The trisection gives $\angle ADP=30^\circ$ and $\angle ADB=60^\circ$. Thus $DP=2\sqrt3/3$, $AP=\sqrt3/3$, $DB=2$, and $AB=\sqrt3$.
Hence $PB=AB-AP=2\sqrt3/3$. The perimeter is $DP+PB+DB=2+4\sqrt3/3$.
stepsZh: 三等分得 $\angle ADP=30^\circ$，$\angle ADB=60^\circ$。于是 $DP=2\sqrt3/3$，$AP=\sqrt3/3$，$DB=2$，$AB=\sqrt3$。
所以 $PB=AB-AP=2\sqrt3/3$，周长为 $DP+PB+DB=2+4\sqrt3/3$。

amc10-2000-q8.summary: At a school, $2/5$ of the freshmen and $4/5$ of the sophomores took the AMC 10. The numbers of freshman and sophomore contestants were equal. Which must be true? A five times as many sophomores; B twice as many sophomores; C equal class sizes; D twice as many freshmen; E five times as many freshmen.
amc10-2000-q8.summaryZh: 某校有 $2/5$ 的一年级生和 $4/5$ 的二年级生参加 AMC 10，且两个年级的参赛人数相同。下列哪项必然成立？A 二年级生是一年级生的五倍；B 二倍；C 两年级人数相同；D 一年级生是二年级生的两倍；E 五倍。
amc10-2000-q8.answer: D. There are twice as many freshmen as sophomores.
amc10-2000-q8.answerZh: D．一年级生人数是二年级生的两倍。

methods.title: Equate the two contestant counts
steps: Let the class sizes be $f$ and $s$. Equal contestant counts give $(2/5)f=(4/5)s$.
Multiplying by $5$ and simplifying yields $f=2s$.
stepsZh: 设两年级人数分别为 $f,s$，参赛人数相同给出 $(2/5)f=(4/5)s$。
同乘 $5$ 并化简得 $f=2s$。

methods.title: Remove the absolute value using the sign condition
methods.titleZh: 利用符号条件去绝对值
steps: Therefore $x-p=(2-p)-p=2-2p$.

amc10-2000-q10.summary: Two positive-area triangles have side lengths $4,6,x$ and $4,6,y$. What is the smallest positive number that cannot equal $|x-y|$? Options: A $2$, B $4$, C $6$, D $8$, E $10$.
amc10-2000-q10.summaryZh: 两个面积为正的三角形边长分别为 $4,6,x$ 与 $4,6,y$。不能作为 $|x-y|$ 取值的最小正数是多少？选项为 A $2$，B $4$，C $6$，D $8$，E $10$。

methods.title: Apply the strict triangle inequalities
steps: Positive area requires $|6-4|<x<6+4$ and similarly for $y$, so $2<x,y<10$.
Thus $|x-y|$ can attain every value in $[0,8)$ but cannot attain $8$. The smallest listed positive unattainable value is $8$.
stepsZh: 因此 $|x-y|$ 可取 $[0,8)$ 中所有值，却不能等于 $8$；最小的正不可取值为 $8$。

amc10-2000-q11.summary: Choose two different primes between $4$ and $18$. Which value could equal their product minus their sum? Options: A $21$, B $60$, C $119$, D $180$, E $231$.
amc10-2000-q11.summaryZh: 从 $4$ 与 $18$ 之间选择两个不同质数。它们的积减去和可能等于哪个数？选项为 A $21$，B $60$，C $119$，D $180$，E $231$。

methods.title: Use parity, bounds, and direct verification
methods.titleZh: 利用奇偶性、范围与直接验证
steps: The primes are $5,7,11,13,17$. Their product is odd and their sum even, so the result is odd. It ranges from $5\cdot7-12=23$ to $13\cdot17-30=191$.
Among the options, only $119$ is odd and in this interval; indeed $11\cdot13-(11+13)=143-24=119$.
stepsZh: 质数为 $5,7,11,13,17$。两质数之积为奇数、和为偶数，所以结果为奇数；范围从 $5\cdot7-12=23$ 到 $13\cdot17-30=191$。

amc10-2000-q12.summary: Figures $0,1,2,3$ contain $1,5,13,25$ nonoverlapping unit squares. Equivalently, figure $n$ is a diamond with row lengths $1,3,\ldots,2n+1,\ldots,3,1$. How many unit squares are in figure $100$? Options: A $10401$, B $19801$, C $20201$, D $39801$, E $40801$.
amc10-2000-q12.summaryZh: 图形 $0,1,2,3$ 分别含 $1,5,13,25$ 个互不重叠的单位正方形。等价地，图形 $n$ 是各行长度依次为 $1,3,\ldots,2n+1,\ldots,3,1$ 的菱形阵列。图形 $100$ 含多少个单位正方形？选项为 A $10401$，B $19801$，C $20201$，D $39801$，E $40801$。

methods.title: Sum the odd-number rows
steps: The rows increase through the first $n+1$ odd numbers and then decrease through the first $n$ odd numbers. Their total is $(n+1)^2+n^2$.
stepsZh: 各行先经过前 $n+1$ 个奇数，再反向经过前 $n$ 个奇数，总数为 $(n+1)^2+n^2$。

amc10-2000-q13.summary: A triangular board has five horizontal rows of lengths $1,2,3,4,5$ and five vertical columns of lengths $5,4,3,2,1$. Place $5$ yellow, $4$ red, $3$ green, $2$ blue, and $1$ orange peg in its $15$ positions so no row or column repeats a color. How many placements are possible? Options: A $0$, B $1$, C $5!4!3!2!1!$, D $15!/(5!4!3!2!1!)$, E $15!$.
amc10-2000-q13.summaryZh: 一个三角形钉板有长度为 $1,2,3,4,5$ 的五个横行，以及长度为 $5,4,3,2,1$ 的五个竖列，共 $15$ 个位置。放置 $5$ 个黄钉、$4$ 个红钉、$3$ 个绿钉、$2$ 个蓝钉和 $1$ 个橙钉，要求任一横行或竖列中同色不重复。共有多少种放法？选项为 A $0$，B $1$，C $5!4!3!2!1!$，D $15!/(5!4!3!2!1!)$，E $15!$。

methods.title: Force one colour at a time
steps: Five yellow pegs must occupy one position in each of the five rows and columns; on this triangular board that forces the long diagonal.
After removing those positions, the four red pegs are similarly forced into the only four-row/four-column diagonal. Repeating for green, blue, and orange fixes every position uniquely.
stepsZh: 五个黄钉必须在五个横行和五个竖列中各占一个位置，在该三角板上这强制它们位于最长对角线上。
删去这些位置后，四个红钉同样被强制放在唯一覆盖四行四列的对角线上；继续对绿、蓝、橙色重复，所有位置都唯一确定。

amc10-2000-q14.summary: The scores $71,76,80,82,91$ were entered in some order. After each entry, the average of all scores entered so far was an integer. Which score was entered last? Options: A $71$, B $76$, C $80$, D $82$, E $91$.
amc10-2000-q14.summaryZh: 分数 $71,76,80,82,91$ 按某种顺序录入。每录入一个分数后，当前所有已录入分数的平均数始终是整数。最后录入的是哪个分数？选项为 A $71$，B $76$，C $80$，D $82$，E $91$。

methods.title: Use divisibility of partial sums
steps: The first three scores must sum to a multiple of $3$. Their residues modulo $3$ show the only possible triple is $76,82,91$, with sum $249$. The first two must have even sum, so they are $76,82$ and the third is $91$.
Since $249\equiv1\pmod4$, the fourth score must be $3\pmod4$, namely $71$. Thus $80$ is last. The final total $400$ is divisible by $5$, so the order is valid.
stepsZh: 前三个分数之和须被 $3$ 整除。考察模 $3$ 余数可知唯一可能三元组为 $76,82,91$，和为 $249$。前两个的平均数为整数，故前两个是 $76,82$，第三个是 $91$。
因为 $249\equiv1\pmod4$，第四个分数须模 $4$ 余 $3$，即 $71$。所以最后是 $80$；总和 $400$ 可被 $5$ 整除。

amc10-2000-q15.summary: Nonzero real numbers $a,b$ satisfy $ab=a-b$. Which is a possible value of $a/b+b/a-ab$? Options: A $-2$, B $-1/2$, C $1/3$, D $1/2$, E $2$.
amc10-2000-q15.summaryZh: 非零实数 $a,b$ 满足 $ab=a-b$。$a/b+b/a-ab$ 的一个可能值是？选项为 A $-2$，B $-1/2$，C $1/3$，D $1/2$，E $2$。

methods.title: Combine over a common denominator
steps: Combine the terms: $a/b+b/a-ab=(a^2+b^2-a^2b^2)/(ab)$.
Because $ab=a-b$, we have $a^2b^2=(a-b)^2$. The numerator becomes $a^2+b^2-(a-b)^2=2ab$, so the expression equals $2$.

amc10-2000-q16.summary: On a unit square lattice, take $A=(0,3)$, $B=(6,0)$, $C=(4,2)$, and $D=(2,0)$. Segments $AB$ and $CD$ meet at $E$. Find $AE$. Options: A $4\sqrt5/3$, B $5\sqrt5/3$, C $12\sqrt5/7$, D $2\sqrt5$, E $5\sqrt{65}/9$.

methods.title: Find the intersection in coordinates
steps: Line $AB$ is $x+2y=6$, while line $CD$ is $x-y=2$. Solving gives $E=(10/3,4/3)$.

amc10-2000-q17.summary: A machine exchanges one quarter for five nickels, one nickel for five pennies, or one penny for five quarters. Starting with one penny, which amount could occur after repeated exchanges? Options: A 3.63, B 5.13, C 6.30, D 7.45, E 9.07 dollars.
amc10-2000-q17.summaryZh: 一台机器可把一枚 25 美分硬币换成五枚 5 美分硬币，把一枚 5 美分硬币换成五枚 1 美分硬币，或把一枚 1 美分硬币换成五枚 25 美分硬币。从一枚 1 美分硬币开始，反复兑换后可能得到哪个总金额？选项为 A 3.63，B 5.13，C 6.30，D 7.45，E 9.07 美元。

methods.title: Track the value invariant modulo 124 cents
methods.titleZh: 追踪金额模 124 美分的不变量
steps: The quarter-to-nickels and nickel-to-pennies exchanges preserve value. A penny-to-quarters exchange increases the value by $125-1=124$ cents.
Thus every total is $1+124n$ cents. These totals are attainable because one new quarter can be changed through nickels back to pennies to enable another cycle. Only $745=1+124\cdot6$ matches.
stepsZh: 25 美分换 5 美分、5 美分换 1 美分都保持总金额不变；1 美分换五枚 25 美分使金额增加 $125-1=124$ 美分。
因此总金额恒为 $1+124n$ 美分。每次可把新得到的一枚 25 美分继续换成 1 美分以启动下一轮，故这些值可达。只有 $745=1+124\cdot6$ 符合。

amc10-2000-q18.summary: A person walks once around the boundary of a square of side $5$ km and can see all points within horizontal distance $1$ km of every point on the path. Find the total visible area, in square kilometres, rounded to the nearest integer. Options: A $24$, B $27$, C $39$, D $40$, E $42$.
amc10-2000-q18.summaryZh: 一人沿边长 $5$ km 的正方形边界走一周，在路径上任一点都能看到水平距离不超过 $1$ km 的所有点。求整个可见区域面积（平方千米），四舍五入到整数。选项为 A $24$，B $27$，C $39$，D $40$，E $42$。

methods.title: Decompose the one-kilometre boundary band
methods.titleZh: 分解宽一千米的边界带
steps: Inside the square, everything except the central $3\times3$ square is visible, giving $25-9=16$.
Outside are four $5\times1$ rectangles plus four quarter-circles of radius $1$, giving $20+\pi$. The total is $36+\pi\approx39.14$, which rounds to $39$.
stepsZh: 正方形内部除中央 $3\times3$ 正方形外都可见，面积为 $25-9=16$。
外部由四个 $5\times1$ 长方形及四个半径为 $1$ 的四分之一圆组成，面积为 $20+\pi$。总面积 $36+\pi\approx39.14$，四舍五入得 $39$。

amc10-2000-q19.summary: Through a point on a right triangle's hypotenuse, draw lines parallel to the legs, dividing the triangle into a square and two smaller right triangles. One small triangle has area $m$ times the square's area. What is the other small triangle's area divided by the square's area? Options: A $1/(2m+1)$, B $m$, C $1-m$, D $1/(4m)$, E $1/(8m^2)$.
amc10-2000-q19.summaryZh: 过直角三角形斜边上一点分别作两直角边的平行线，将原三角形分成一个正方形和两个小直角三角形。一个小三角形的面积是正方形面积的 $m$ 倍。另一个小三角形面积与正方形面积之比是多少？选项为 A $1/(2m+1)$，B $m$，C $1-m$，D $1/(4m)$，E $1/(8m^2)$。

methods.title: Scale the square and use similarity
methods.titleZh: 令正方形边长为一并利用相似
steps: Scale the square to side $1$. If the first triangle's other perpendicular leg is $r$, its area ratio is $r/2=m$, so $r=2m$.
The two small right triangles are similar; the corresponding other leg of the second is $1/r$. Its area ratio is $(1/2)(1/r)=1/(2r)=1/(4m)$.
stepsZh: 令正方形边长为 $1$。若第一个小三角形的另一条直角边为 $r$，其面积比为 $r/2=m$，故 $r=2m$。
两个小直角三角形相似，第二个对应的另一条直角边为 $1/r$。其面积比为 $(1/2)(1/r)=1/(2r)=1/(4m)$。

amc10-2000-q20.summary: Nonnegative integers $A,M,C$ satisfy $A+M+C=10$. Maximise $AMC+AM+MC+CA$. Options: A $49$, B $59$, C $69$, D $79$, E $89$.
amc10-2000-q20.summaryZh: 非负整数 $A,M,C$ 满足 $A+M+C=10$。求 $AMC+AM+MC+CA$ 的最大值。选项为 A $49$，B $59$，C $69$，D $79$，E $89$。

methods.title: Convert to a balanced product
steps: Expanding shows $AMC+AM+MC+CA=(A+1)(M+1)(C+1)-11$.
The positive integers $A+1,M+1,C+1$ sum to $13$. Their product is maximised by the most balanced split $4,4,5$, giving $80$. Therefore the maximum is $80-11=69$.
stepsZh: 展开得 $AMC+AM+MC+CA=(A+1)(M+1)(C+1)-11$。
正整数 $A+1,M+1,C+1$ 之和为 $13$，乘积在最均衡分配 $4,4,5$ 时最大，为 $80$。故最大值为 $80-11=69$。

amc10-2000-q21.summary: All alligators are ferocious, and some creepy crawlers are alligators. Which must be true? I All alligators are creepy crawlers. II Some ferocious creatures are creepy crawlers. III Some alligators are not creepy crawlers. Options: A I only, B II only, C III only, D II and III only, E none.
amc10-2000-q21.summaryZh: 所有短吻鳄都是凶猛生物，且有些爬虫是短吻鳄。下列哪些必然为真？I 所有短吻鳄都是爬虫；II 有些凶猛生物是爬虫；III 有些短吻鳄不是爬虫。选项为 A 仅 I，B 仅 II，C 仅 III，D 仅 II、III，E 都不必然。

methods.title: Follow the guaranteed set inclusion
methods.titleZh: 追踪必然成立的集合包含关系
steps: The stated creatures that are both creepy crawlers and alligators must also be ferocious, so II is guaranteed.
I need not hold because other alligators may lie outside the creepy-crawler set. III need not hold because all alligators could lie inside it. Thus only II must be true.
stepsZh: 题设保证存在既是爬虫又是短吻鳄的个体，而所有短吻鳄都凶猛，所以 II 必然成立。
其他短吻鳄可能不属于爬虫，故 I 不必然；也可能所有短吻鳄都属于爬虫，故 III 不必然。因此只有 II 必然成立。

amc10-2000-q22.summary: Each of $n$ family members drank an $8$-ounce nontrivial coffee-milk mixture. Angela drank one quarter of all the milk and one sixth of all the coffee. Find $n$. Options: A $3$, B $4$, C $5$, D $6$, E $7$.
amc10-2000-q22.summaryZh: 一家 $n$ 口每人喝一杯 $8$ 盎司且咖啡、牛奶均非零的混合饮料。Angela 喝掉了全家牛奶总量的四分之一及咖啡总量的六分之一。求 $n$。选项为 A $3$，B $4$，C $5$，D $6$，E $7$。

methods.title: Bound a weighted average
steps: Let total milk and coffee be $M,C>0$. Angela's cup satisfies $M/4+C/6=8$, while the family total is $M+C=8n$. Thus $(M/4+C/6)/(M+C)=1/n$.
Because both ingredients are positive, this weighted average lies strictly between $1/6$ and $1/4$. Hence $1/6<1/n<1/4$, so $4<n<6$ and $n=5$.
stepsZh: 设全家牛奶、咖啡总量为 $M,C>0$。Angela 的杯子满足 $M/4+C/6=8$，全家总量为 $M+C=8n$，故 $(M/4+C/6)/(M+C)=1/n$。
由于两种成分均为正，该加权平均严格介于 $1/6$ 与 $1/4$ 之间。因此 $1/6<1/n<1/4$，即 $4<n<6$，所以 $n=5$。

amc10-2000-q23.summary: For the list $10,2,5,2,4,2,x$, the mean, median, and mode, arranged increasingly, form a nonconstant arithmetic progression. Find the sum of all possible real $x$. Options: A $3$, B $6$, C $9$, D $17$, E $20$.
amc10-2000-q23.summaryZh: 数列 $10,2,5,2,4,2,x$ 的平均数、中位数、众数按递增顺序排列后构成非常数等差数列。求所有可能实数 $x$ 之和。选项为 A $3$，B $6$，C $9$，D $17$，E $20$。

methods.title: Split according to the median
steps: The mode is $2$ and the mean is $\mu=(25+x)/7$. If $x\le2$, the median is also $2$, impossible for a nonconstant three-term progression.
If $2<x<4$, the median is $x$ and $x-2=\mu-x$, giving $x=3$. If $x\ge4$, the median is $4$ and $4-2=\mu-4$, giving $\mu=6$ and $x=17$. Both satisfy their cases, so the requested sum is $3+17=20$.
stepsZh: 众数为 $2$，平均数为 $\mu=(25+x)/7$。若 $x\le2$，中位数也为 $2$，无法形成非常数三项等差数列。
若 $2<x<4$，中位数为 $x$，由 $x-2=\mu-x$ 得 $x=3$。若 $x\ge4$，中位数为 $4$，由 $4-2=\mu-4$ 得 $\mu=6,x=17$。二者均满足相应范围，所求和为 $3+17=20$。

amc10-2000-q24.summary: A function satisfies $f(x/3)=x^2+x+1$. Find the sum of all $z$ satisfying $f(3z)=7$. Options: A $-1/3$, B $-1/9$, C $0$, D $5/9$, E $5/3$.

methods.title: Substitute and use Vieta's formula
steps: To make $x/3=3z$, set $x=9z$. Hence $f(3z)=81z^2+9z+1$.
Setting this equal to $7$ gives $81z^2+9z-6=0$. The sum of its roots is $-9/81=-1/9$.

amc10-2000-q25.summary: In year $N$, day $300$ is Tuesday. In year $N+1$, day $200$ is also Tuesday. On what weekday was day $100$ of year $N-1$? Options: A Thursday, B Friday, C Saturday, D Sunday, E Monday.
amc10-2000-q25.summaryZh: 在 $N$ 年，第 $300$ 天是星期二；在 $N+1$ 年，第 $200$ 天也是星期二。$N-1$ 年的第 $100$ 天是星期几？选项为 A 星期四，B 星期五，C 星期六，D 星期日，E 星期一。

methods.title: Count days modulo seven
steps: From day $300$ of year $N$ to day $200$ of year $N+1$ are $L-100$ days, where $L$ is $365$ or $366$. Equal weekdays require divisibility by $7$; only $366-100=266=38\cdot7$ works, so $N$ is a leap year.
Year $N-1$ is ordinary. From its day $100$ to day $300$ of year $N$ are $(365-100)+300=565\equiv5\pmod7$ days. Five days before Tuesday is Thursday.
stepsZh: 从 $N$ 年第 $300$ 天到 $N+1$ 年第 $200$ 天相隔 $L-100$ 天，其中 $L$ 为 $365$ 或 $366$。同为星期二要求被 $7$ 整除；只有 $366-100=266=38\cdot7$ 成立，所以 $N$ 是闰年。
$N-1$ 年为平年。从其第 $100$ 天到 $N$ 年第 $300$ 天相隔 $(365-100)+300=565\equiv5\pmod7$ 天。比星期二早五天是星期四。
